sermons.title: Sermon 1886 | God's Remembrance of His Covenant

scripture.verse: Such pity as a father has

sermons.title: Sermon 1889 | The Blood of Sprinkling (Second Sermon.)

scripture.verse: "Ye are come . . .. to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel. See that ye refuse not him that speaketh."

sermons.title: Sermon 1890 | Our Lord's Prayer for His People's Sanctification

scripture.verse: "Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth."

sermons.title: Sermon 1891 | The Sermon of the Seasons

scripture.verse: "While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease."

sermons.title: Sermon 1893 | Jesus Angry with Hard Hearts

scripture.verse: "And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand."

sermons.title: Sermon 1894 | The Two Appearings and the Discipline of Grace
